<!-- updated 2026-03-23: replaced tier-based quotas with usage-based free limit -->

**Outcome**: Tenants without a payment method get 100 free captures per month. After that, a payment method is required to continue capturing. There are no tiers, no plans, no upgrade paths. The quota system enforces only this single gate: free limit for anonymous usage, unlimited for paying tenants.

**Success criteria**:
- Default free limit: 100 captures/month (no payment method required)
- Quota check runs before browser session creation in the capture pipeline
- Exceeding free limit without payment method returns 429 with `{ "error": "payment_required", "detail": "free capture limit reached - add a payment method to continue", "limit": 100, "used": N }`
- Tenants with a valid payment method on file have no capture limit (billing handles cost)
- Per-tenant quota overrides stored in D1 (operator can grant custom free limits)
- Web UI usage dashboard shows current period captures used, free limit remaining (or "unlimited" if paying), and current charges
- Usage dashboard updates on page load (reads from D1 usage counters)
- Quota enforcement is best-effort (eventual consistency of usage counters means slight overages are acceptable)

**Scope**:
- In: Free-limit enforcement, pre-capture payment-method check, 429 payment_required response, per-tenant D1 overrides, web UI usage dashboard
- Out: Tier system (free/pro/enterprise), automatic tier upgrades, storage quotas (not billed), per-endpoint API call quotas, storage cleanup/eviction

**Constraints**:
- Depends on R25 (usage metering) for counter data and R21 (per-tenant rate limiting) for the rate limit infrastructure
- Depends on R29 (Stripe) for payment method status check
- Quota check must not add >10ms latency to the capture request (single D1 read, cached if possible)
- Must handle race conditions gracefully - two concurrent captures near the limit may both proceed; slight overages are acceptable
